units: metres unless a field explicitly names centimetres
scope: CPU asset refinement only. No game, production manifest, tests, or other anatomy modules were edited. No internet requests or downloads were used.
reviewBoundary: No rendered appearance or hardware review was performed. The requested CPU-only scope supersedes the repository's lab and screenshot workflow for this task.

baseline.basis: Measurements A–G use the shipped GLB, not a rebuild of the pre-edit source. The shipped geometry differs from the current pre-edit authoring source. J uses actual pre-edit and post-edit compiler outputs.

rig.soleNote: The authored vertices are exactly y=0. Float32 skin matrices produce approximately +1.07e-9 m at the exported bind sole. Animation keys target +1 mm to leave room for interpolation without changing the bind sole.

A.target: 40 evenly spaced sections per leg; every interior valley depth <= 0.12 of the smaller neighbouring maximum.
A.method: Skinned bind-space triangle intersections with 40 horizontal planes from the foot's lowest vertex to the Upper joint origin. The centre follows sole-patch centroid, Paw, Ankle, Lower and Upper joints. At each plane, 64 angular rays intersect the actual mesh; intervals are unioned per connected component and across overlapping surfaces. Radius is sqrt(mean(r^2)), the polar area-equivalent radius of the union containing the centre. Above the torso junction this includes the attached torso. The sole limit is evaluated 1e-7 m above its plane. Missing contours are recorded as zero, never interpolated. Flat extrema use a 1e-7 m equality tolerance; endpoints can bound an interior valley. All four full curves are retained.

B.method: Unmodified project paw-contact-audit.mjs, terminal paw weight >=0.5, 0.003 m band. Slice numbering here is 1-based, rear to front.

C.method: Paw region uses terminal joint weight >=0.5. The primary 16-bin curve projects actual triangles clipped to the 3–30 mm band, including edge intersections at bin boundaries. Triangles must have all three vertices in the paw region. The vertex-only projection is also retained; unlike the primary curve, sparse baseline vertices can create false valleys. Values are forward distance from the Paw joint. Bin indices are zero-based and equal-height plateaus count as one extremum. Grooves are measured on triangle/plane sections every 0.25 mm from 0 to 30 mm, requiring >=2 mm prominence, and matched to their band-projection bin within one bin. lowestHeightM is the first qualifying sampled height, with the preceding 0.25 mm sample below threshold. Threshold-neighbour samples are retained. No qualifying baseline groove exists in the primary band projection.

D.method: Ear joint weight >=0.99. Ear-tip height is the highest Anatomy vertex, including the rim. Tuft height is the highest detail vertex on that ear whose maximum linear RGB channel is below 0.08.

target.distalColour: Darker than mid-tail, with a solid black tip

E.method: Tail-weighted vertices are grouped by their joint-weight signature into the 21 exported tube rings. Duplicate seam positions are removed before averaging each ring's centre. Length is the sum along those centres. Colours are mean linear vertex RGB over rings at 35–60% and >=70% of measured arc length. The candidate's distal rings all share the same dark colour.

F.target: Sacrum top >= scapula top in the skinned bind pose.
F.method: Highest Anatomy triangle intersection at the rear hip station z=-0.40 m and front shoulder station z=+0.31 m, restricted to the central |x|<0.09 m dorsal region. These are geometric surface heights, not bone heights.

G.method: every animation key time and interval midpoint; all skinned vertices; skinned world space

H.actualExecution: Installed Node with local tsx/esm; unmodified builder, using an in-process Playwright launch override for installed Chrome. See reproduction.builderPowerShell.
